name: A Dark Threat Looms
summary: At the Stonewrought Dam, sabotage threatens a vital barrier in Loch Modan. A barrel hidden near the water holds strange smelling powder, and you bring a sample to Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII.

sections.title: A Suspicious Discovery
sections.body: Whispers of sabotage have drawn attention to the shoreline around the Stonewrought Dam. Near the water's edge, an out-of-place barrel holds strange, pungent powder that has no place among the dam's maintenance supplies.

sections.title: Alarm at the Dam
sections.body: Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII grows alarmed at once when you bring him a sample. His alarm confirms Loch Modan's worst fears: an outside force plots against the dam, and the inquiry becomes an urgent matter of regional defense.

faq.q: What is the strange smelling powder?
faq.answer: The strange smelling powder in the barrel is an explosive or alchemical agent planted near the Stonewrought Dam's base. It is direct evidence that an enemy plots to destroy or compromise the great barrier.

faq.q: Who is Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII?
faq.answer: Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII is the dwarven master engineer overseeing the Stonewrought Dam's maintenance, integrity, and safety in Loch Modan.

faq.q: Where is the suspicious barrel found?
faq.answer: The suspicious barrel is tucked away along the shoreline near the Stonewrought Dam's foundation in northern Loch Modan.

faq.q: Why is the Stonewrought Dam being targeted?
faq.answer: The Stonewrought Dam holds back the massive reservoir of Loch Modan. If breached, catastrophic flooding would tear through the Wetlands below, crippling Alliance trade routes and devastating dwarven holdings across Khaz Modan.

faq.q: Who left the suspicious barrel here?
faq.answer: Agents seeking to destabilize dwarven lands placed the barrel, prompting Chief Engineer Hinderweir to begin a broader investigation into who is behind the plot.

faq.q: What should I do after collecting the powder?
faq.answer: Take the sample to Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII atop the Stonewrought Dam so he can inspect the substance and prepare a response.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you know the Stonewrought Dam as one of the Ironforge dwarves' crowning architectural feats. Any threat to its integrity strikes at the safety and pride of Khaz Modan.
As a gnome, you appreciate the precision behind dwarven civil works, which makes the chemical nature of this crude sabotage especially concerning.
As an engineer, you sense danger in volatile powders deliberately planted at the structural stress points of a major dam.
